text:
maria: heads up — after the kernel-selector change in today's deploy I see a p99 spike on PP 1F1B runs with microbatch=4. baseline was stable, now +12ms p99 and throughput down ~8%. :eyes:

alex: can you paste the run id + config? which models/hardware?

maria: reproducer: model=rwkv-30b-quant, infra=dedicated-gpu-pool, tp=2, pp=4, microbatch=4, device=8xA100-NVLink. deploy tag: inference-v3.2.1.

maria: quick perf log (from bench harness):
```
2026-03-17T15:12:03Z ITER 100: tokens/s 1204 -> 1111 (baseline 1208)
avg step latency 48.1ms -> 53.6ms, p99 96.2ms -> 108.1ms
allreduce avg 1.8ms -> 3.6ms, comm/compute overlap 28% -> 12%
```

jin: hmm looks like allreduce time doubled. did kernel-selector flip to fused-kernel preference? those produce smaller compute chunks for microbatches which hurts overlap.

alex: last change was "prefer_fused_matmul=true" in kernel heuristic for quantized paths. @maria can you try forcing prefer_fused_matmul=false locally and re-run?

maria: running now. repro command: `./run_perf.sh --tag local-debug --microbatch 4 --pp 4 --tp 2 --model rwkv-30b-quant --kernel-selector override:false`

bench-bot: perf-run 2615033001 completed: tokens/s 1198, avg latency 48.7ms, p99 98.0ms, allreduce avg 1.9ms, overlap 30%

maria: forcing selector off drops p99 back near baseline. so selector change is likely culprit.

jin: that matches my mental model. fused kernel reduces arithmetic ops per launch but increases kernel launch frequency for short sequences, so smaller microbatches lose compute time to launches and can't hide allreduce.

alex: two actionable fixes: 1) quick canary revert of prefer_fused_matmul for quantized models on hosted/dedicated 2) improve selector heuristics to factor microbatch size + pp imbalance before preferring fused.

maria: agree. also noticed KV cache churn in traces; warmup after switching model revision shows repeated KV allocation/free. snippet from trace:
```
KVCache::get shard=2 miss->alloc 128MB x3 within 200ms
KVCache::evict shard=1 force-evict last_used 120ms
```

jin: eviction spikes could worsen latency for 1F1B since cache misses force recompute + extra comm. can we bump kvcache_prefetch window and increase max_cache_size by 20% on canary?

alex: yes do both for canary. also add a short perf job that sweeps microbatch sizes [4,6,8] and records overlap/allreduce metrics. we need to prove selector+kvcombo.

maria: scheduling those now. quick numbers after forcing selector off + kvcache tweak: tokens/s 1210, p99 97ms, allreduce 1.85ms, overlap 31%.

sre-bot: created incident-ticket #INF-4721 for regression, assigned to @alex/@maria, priority P2. added traces and bench artifacts.

alex: plan: revert selector in canary (15% traffic), apply kvcache size bump, run microbatch sweep, collect flamegraphs + NCCL trace. if canary looks good roll forward, else revert globally. jin can you draft selector heuristic patch to consider microbatch*pp vs kernel throughput?

jin: on it — will prototype heuristic: score = (kernel_tp * microbatch) - launch_penalty*(pp) + kvcache_penalty. pushing PR for review later today. :shipit:

maria: thanks — will post canary results here in ~2h. tagging @bench-bot to run scheduled sweep. :thumbsup:
